translation:
One can see that all along the skin and flesh were numb, only not yet to the point of paralysis.

Twenty-three: Since I began rubbing the jaw, the neck bone has already become thin, but at Dazhui there was still one small strip of accumulation, so I pulled its root to extract it. The more I pulled, the higher it went, and the whole crown became hard; I thought the remaining accumulation had all gone up, so I pulled in front of Quepen. Pulling until it was as thin as the neck, I then knew that it was also a great root that had already half entered the front and descended; it finished in about an hour.
